story_type: National Guard Black Hawk hoists residents out of a town flood
hook: Stranded in rushing floodwater in Louisiana.
narration: Floodwater was rushing past this car, and someone was still out in it.
In March 2016, a Louisiana National Guard Black Hawk crew flew in to reach people stranded in the flood.
The crew hovered over the trees and sent a rescuer down the cable.
A hoist lets a helicopter lift people straight up from places it could never land.
On the ground, a Guardsman carried a woman from her car.
[short pause] One after another, people rode the cable up into the Black Hawk.
outcome: The Guard crew rescued the stranded residents from the floodwaters in Winnfield.
title: Black Hawk lifts them out of a flood
description:
A Louisiana National Guard UH-60 Black Hawk crew from Fox Company, 2-135th General Aviation Battalion, rescues residents stranded in floodwaters in Winnfield, Louisiana, March 10, 2016.
